description: Same as find_skill: search verified, replayable browser skills for doing a task on a website or web app. Returns cid, site, site_kind (real or demo/mock), params, risk flags, verified run and replay counts and how_to_run. This HTTP endpoint does not offer run_skill; allowlisted skills can be tried with try_skill.

limit.description: max results: default 3, up to 5 (larger values return at most 5); only matches above the confidence threshold are returned, so there may be fewer

query.description: the task in plain words, e.g. "create a support ticket for dana@globex.com"

name: search_skills
title: Search browser skills
